text: Lights out. Seven seconds each. Roll the files.
Iron Man. Built it in a cave.
Shield up. Frozen in the forties.
Thor. Son of Odin. Don't touch the hammer.
The Hulk. He did warn you.
A king, a claw, a hidden nation.
Black Panther. Wakanda forever. Case closed.
Wolverine. Best there is at what he does.
Doctor Strange. The cape has opinions.
Thanos. The Mad Titan. Snap. Case closed.
Special case. Eyes only. That's all you get.
Loki. God of Mischief. Burdened with glorious purpose.
Two minds. One very hungry suit.
Root of the problem. Vocabulary: limited.
Groot. I am Groot. Case closed.
Hawkeye. Best aim on the team.
Rocket. Don't call him a raccoon.
Scarlet Witch. Chaos magic. Case closed.
Ant-Man. His best friends are ants.
Special case. One piece of evidence. Whose is it?
Ghost Rider. Hell on wheels. Case closed.
Storm. Chance of lightning: all of it.
Halfway there. Twenty-five closed. Tally your score.
Professor X. He heard you think that.
Beast. Fur, fangs, PhD. Case closed.
Vision. Powered by the Mind Stone.
Special case. Half a shadow. Half the answer.
A ghost with a metal arm.
The Winter Soldier. Long way from Brooklyn.
Gamora. Adopted daughter of Thanos. Case closed.
Doctor Octopus. Doc Ock to his friends.
Mysterio. Nothing you saw was real.
The Human Torch. Fantastic Four's hothead.
Mister Fantastic. Fantastic Four's leader. Case closed.
Special case. Two suspects. One of them is lying.
Nick Fury. He's got one eye on you.
Blade. Sunlight? No problem. Case closed.
Metaphors go right over his head.
Drax. His reflexes are too fast.
Shang-Chi. Master of the Ten Rings.
The Invisible Woman. Now you see her.
Iron Fist. And that's all fifty.
Last special case. Out of focus. Still unmistakable.
Case closed. Ninety percent? Legend. Sixty? Hero. Thirty? Sidekick. Less? Civilian. Comment your score. Subscribe.
